The '''Belovians'''<ref name="BtS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref> were the inhabitants of the [[Belovia system/Legends|Belovia system]].<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=Belovians|system=[[Belovia system/Legends|Belovia system]]|legends=1}}</ref> They were directly represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]].<ref name="BtS" />
